title: FrameflowBrief
description: What the creator asked for, as the editor understood it - confirmed with the creator before any storyboard is written.

format.description: The kind of video in a few words, e.g. "fashion reel", "YouTube explainer", "product pitch", "startup pitch".

aspect.description: 16:9 for YouTube and pitches, 9:16 for Reels, Shorts and TikTok, 1:1 for square feeds.

fps.description: Optional; 30 when absent, or the footage's own rate.

summary.description: Two or three sentences for the creator: what this video is, what it shows, and how it ends (the call to action).

skills.description: Optional: skills from the creator's library this video will use, each with why.

open_questions.description: Anything essential the prompt left open. Ask the creator these before going on.
